description: Extract the public article page's visual body into a shared, presentational React component `components/news/ArticleView.tsx` so BOTH the public route and the new admin preview render identical markup. This is the parity mechanism: one component = one look. The public page (app/(site)/news/[slug]/page.tsx) keeps ALL its data fetching, generateMetadata, JSON-LD emission, and the Related Articles section; only the header/byline/hero-image/body/editorial-notice/FAQ/author-bio markup moves into ArticleView. The rendered HTML and JSON-LD of the public route MUST remain byte-for-byte equivalent. Independent of FEAT-002/003 in that it introduces no behavior change on its own.

acceptance_criteria: components/news/ArticleView.tsx exists and renders the article header, byline, hero image, PortableText body, editorial notice, FAQ section, and author bio using the identical Tailwind classes and DOM structure the public page used before.
app/(site)/news/[slug]/page.tsx renders <ArticleView> for the article body and still emits the Article JSON-LD script and (when faqs exist) the FAQ JSON-LD script, unchanged.
The public article route's produced DOM (element nesting, classNames, attributes) and both JSON-LD blocks are equivalent to before the refactor — no visual or schema change.
No unused imports/vars remain in page.tsx (would fail `next lint`).
ArticleView takes a resolved `Article` object and does no data fetching of its own.
verification: Static review: diff app/(site)/news/[slug]/page.tsx against the pre-refactor version and confirm the only changes are (a) moved JSX now living in ArticleView and (b) removed-because-unused imports; JSON-LD scripts, metadata, and data fetching are unchanged.
Static review: read components/news/ArticleView.tsx and confirm classNames/structure match the original page markup verbatim.
On push, GitHub Actions CI (`npm ci && next build && next lint`) must pass — this is the authoritative build/lint gate. Local build/lint is not possible under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY.
findings: Created components/news/ArticleView.tsx as a presentational (no 'use client', no data fetching) component taking a resolved Article plus optional authorSlug and optional children. All the header/breadcrumb/CategoryBadge/hero-title/deck/Byline/hero-figure/PortableTextRenderer-body/editorial-notice/FAQ/author-bio JSX was moved verbatim from app/(site)/news/[slug]/page.tsx with every className and attribute preserved. Boundary choice (documented in the component doc comment): ArticleView renders the outer `<div className="container-page section-padding">` and inner `<article className="container-prose">`, then renders `children` as a sibling of <article> inside the container div — exactly where the Related Articles <section> previously sat. The public page now passes its Related Articles <section> as children, keeping the produced DOM nesting/classNames/attributes byte-for-byte identical. The two JSON-LD <script> tags (Article + FAQ), generateMetadata, generateStaticParams, revalidate=300, getArticleBySlug/getRelatedArticles calls, and authorSlug/articleSchema/generateFAQSchema construction all stay on page.tsx unchanged. Removed now-unused imports from page.tsx: next/image Image, PortableTextRenderer, CategoryBadge, Byline. Kept Metadata, Link (still used by Related section), notFound, siteConfig, getArticleBySlug, getRelatedArticles, generateArticleSchema, generateFAQSchema, ArticleCard, Reveal, sampleArticles. TS strict: authorSlug prop is string|undefined matching article.author?.slug?.current; author-bio aside guarded with article.author?.bio; Byline receives the full Author (structurally compatible with its narrower {name; imageUrl?} prop, same as before). VERIFICATION LIMITATION: could not run `next build`/`next lint`/`tsc` locally under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (no npm registry / incomplete node_modules) — validated by careful static review only. GitHub Actions CI (npm ci && next build && next lint) is the authoritative gate on push.
